rationale: New global and per-space low-only Zigbee signal mode with an inclusive LQI threshold of 50; extends persisted settings compatibly without a model version change.

summary.ru: Добавлен режим показа только низкого Zigbee-сигнала (LQI не выше 50).
summary.en: Add low-only Zigbee signal visibility for LQI values up to 50.
